title: Email: Categories request to re-add fragrance variant to Aurora scope
content:
From: David Osei (Categories)
To: Jane Smith (OCM)
CC: Carlos Mendez (Marketing)
Date: 24 February 2026
Subject: Project Aurora – Fragrance Variant Scope Request

Hi Jane,

Following last week's commercial review, the Categories team would like to formally request that the fragrance variant is added back into the Aurora launch scope for the UK market.

Background: Consumer research completed in January showed strong purchase intent for a complementary fragrance option alongside the original. The UK Category team believes this could add 15–20% incremental volume in year one.

Proposed scope:
- Aurora Fragrance Variant 250ml, UK only
- Same formula base as Original, different fragrance component (to be confirmed with R&D)
- Same packaging structure, different label design
- Target launch date unchanged at 01 October 2026

We appreciate this is a significant request at G3 and would want to understand the full impact on timeline, cost and resource before committing. Could you organise an impact assessment and bring this to the governance board by end of March?

Happy to discuss further.

David
